Jaghanacapalā
poetess. Q. by Veṇīdatta in his Padyaveṇī 325. Padyaracanā 36. 52. Kvs. 518.
See J. Myth. Soc. XXV. p. 63; J. B. Chaudhuri, Sanskrit Poetesses Part A, intro. p.. xv-xvi; also Subhāṣitaratnakośa intro. p. lxxvii.

Jaghanasthalīghaṭaka
or ºvaTuka sobriequet of poet Argaṭa. Śp. 3354. Sbhv. 1563. Smv. p. 188.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 377; also ‘Sobriquets in Skt.’ JOR. Madras XVIII. p. 255.
